name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: An aria-hidden placeholder in the shape of loading content (a text line, a block, a circle) that pulses slowly.
usage: Use Skeleton while content with a known shape loads: tree rows, a card, a line of text. Size blocks and circles with classes (h-control-sm w-panel-xs, size-control-md); text lines take the body text size. Mark the loading region aria-busy and name it (aria-label "Loading tables") or add a labelled Spinner. Keep the skeleton's layout close to the real content so nothing jumps. For an unknown shape use Spinner; for measurable progress use Progress.

props.name: variant
props.description: text: a body line; block: a rectangle; circle: an avatar.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The placeholder in color.bg.inset, aria-hidden; data-slot="skeleton", data-variant.

accessibility: Every skeleton is aria-hidden; the loading region carries aria-busy and a name (or a labelled Spinner), so screen readers announce loading once.
Remove aria-busy when the content arrives so the region is read again.
The pulse runs through the Web Animations API at eight motion.duration.slow per beat and never under prefers-reduced-motion.
